post.title: How solar companies make money on $0-down leases
post.ig:
Why would a solar company put panels on your roof for $0 down?

In a lease or PPA the company owns the panels: Sunrun valued each new subscriber at $59,377 in Q2 2026, with an average business tax credit of 44.0%.
The homeowner 25D credit (30%) ended for expenditures after Dec 31, 2025; leased systems can still qualify under 48E into 2027.
On solar loans, the CFPB (Aug 2024) found fees of 10-30% of the cash price built into the principal. Made-up example: $30,000 system + 20% fee = $36,000 loan.

Sources: Sunrun Q2 2026 and Q4 2025 results; IRS Form 5695 instructions; SEIA; CFPB Solar Financing Issue Spotlight (2024).
News and education, not financial advice.
